name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_asthma_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of asthma.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of asthma.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of asthma.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of asthma.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_asthma_now@@defined_by_national_institute_of_health
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's asthma diagnosis is defined by the National Institute of Health.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's asthma diagnosis is defined by the National Institute of Health.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's asthma diagnosis is not defined by the National Institute of Health.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the asthma diagnosis is defined by the National Institute of Health.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_asthma_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has a diagnosis of asthma at any point in their history.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has a diagnosis of asthma at any point in their history.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never had a diagnosis of asthma in their history.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever had a diagnosis of asthma.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_asthma_inthehistory@@duration_at_least_3_months
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's asthma diagnosis has been present for at least 3 months.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's asthma diagnosis has been present for at least 3 months.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's asthma diagnosis has not been present for at least 3 months.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the asthma diagnosis has been present for at least 3 months.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_asthma_inthehistory@@stable_for_at_least_30_days_before_screening_visit
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's asthma diagnosis has been stable for at least 30 days before the screening visit.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's asthma diagnosis has been stable for at least 30 days before the screening visit.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's asthma diagnosis has not been stable for at least 30 days before the screening visit.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the asthma diagnosis has been stable for at least 30 days before the screening visit.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_asthma_inthehistory@@stability_defined_as_no_exacerbations_and_no_changes_in_medication
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's asthma diagnosis stability is defined as no exacerbations and no changes in medication.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's asthma diagnosis stability is defined as no exacerbations and no changes in medication.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's asthma diagnosis stability is not defined as no exacerbations and no changes in medication.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the asthma diagnosis stability is defined as no exacerbations and no changes in medication.

name: asthma_stability_duration_before_screening_visit_value_in_days
meaning: Numeric variable indicating the number of days the patient's asthma diagnosis has been stable (defined as no exacerbations and no changes in medication) before the screening visit.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined how many days the patient's asthma diagnosis has been stable before the screening visit.
when_value: Set to the number of days the patient's asthma diagnosis has been stable (no exacerbations and no changes in medication) before the screening visit.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_asthma_now@@persistent
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's current asthma diagnosis is persistent.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of asthma and the asthma is persistent.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently has a diagnosis of asthma but the asthma is not persistent.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the asthma is persistent.

name: patient_forced_expired_volume_in_1_second_value_recorded_now_withunit_percent
meaning: Numeric percent representing the patient's current FEV1 as a percent of the predicted value for age, height, and sex.
when_unknown: Set to null if no such measurement is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured percent value if the patient's forced expiratory volume in 1 second (FEV1) as a percent of the predicted value is recorded now.

name: patient_forced_expired_volume_in_1_second_value_recorded_now_withunit_percent@@measured_at_screening_visit
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the FEV1 percent value was measured at the screening visit.
when_true: Set to true if the FEV1 percent value was measured at the screening visit.
when_false: Set to false if the FEV1 percent value was not measured at the screening visit.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the FEV1 percent value was measured at the screening visit.

name: patient_fluticasone_propionate_value_recorded_now_withunit_micrograms_per_day
meaning: Numeric value for the patient's current daily dosage of fluticasone propionate (inhaled corticosteroid) in micrograms per day.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient is not currently being treated with fluticasone propionate or the dosage is unknown.
when_value: Set to the current daily dosage (in micrograms per day) if the patient is currently being treated with fluticasone propionate and the dosage is known.

name: patient_fluticasone_propionate_value_recorded_now_withunit_micrograms_per_day@@stable_dosage_for_at_least_4_weeks_before_screening_visit
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's current daily dosage of fluticasone propionate has been stable and administered for at least 4 weeks (28 days) before the screening visit.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current daily dosage of fluticasone propionate has been stable and administered for at least 4 weeks (28 days) before the screening visit.
when_false: Set to false if the dosage has not been stable or not administered for at least 4 weeks before the screening visit.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown or cannot be determined whether the dosage has been stable and administered for at least 4 weeks before the screening visit.

name: patient_equivalent_inhaled_corticosteroid_value_recorded_now_withunit_micrograms_per_day
meaning: Numeric value for the patient's current daily dosage of an inhaled corticosteroid equivalent to fluticasone propionate in micrograms per day.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient is not currently being treated with an equivalent inhaled corticosteroid or the dosage is unknown.
when_value: Set to the current daily dosage (in micrograms per day) if the patient is currently being treated with an inhaled corticosteroid equivalent to fluticasone propionate and the dosage is known.

name: patient_equivalent_inhaled_corticosteroid_value_recorded_now_withunit_micrograms_per_day@@stable_dosage_for_at_least_4_weeks_before_screening_visit
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's current daily dosage of an equivalent inhaled corticosteroid has been stable and administered for at least 4 weeks (28 days) before the screening visit.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current daily dosage of an equivalent inhaled corticosteroid has been stable and administered for at least 4 weeks (28 days) before the screening visit.
when_false: Set to false if the dosage has not been stable or not administered for at least 4 weeks before the screening visit.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown or cannot be determined whether the dosage has been stable and administered for at least 4 weeks before the screening visit.

name: patient_non_corticosteroid_therapy_value_recorded_now_withunit_per_day@@stable_dosage
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's current daily dosage of non-corticosteroid therapy is stable.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current daily dosage of non-corticosteroid therapy is stable.
when_false: Set to false if the dosage is not stable.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown or cannot be determined whether the dosage is stable.

name: patient_fluticasone_propionate_value_recorded_now_withunit_micrograms_per_administration
meaning: Numeric value for the patient's current dose of fluticasone propionate per administration in micrograms.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient is not currently being treated with fluticasone propionate or the dose per administration is unknown.
when_value: Set to the current dose per administration (in micrograms) if the patient is currently being treated with fluticasone propionate and the dose per administration is known.

name: patient_salmeterol_value_recorded_now_withunit_micrograms_per_administration
meaning: Numeric value for the patient's current dose of salmeterol per administration in micrograms.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient is not currently being treated with salmeterol or the dose per administration is unknown.
when_value: Set to the current dose per administration (in micrograms) if the patient is currently being treated with salmeterol and the dose per administration is known.

name: patient_meets_ics_flu_regimen
meaning: Indicates the patient meets the fluticasone propionate inhaled corticosteroid regimen as specified in the inclusion criterion.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently being treated with a stable daily dosage of fluticasone propionate in the range of ≥88 and ≤176 micrograms/day for at least 4 weeks before screening.
when_false: Set to false if the patient does not meet all these criteria.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown whether the patient meets all these criteria.

name: patient_meets_ics_equiv_regimen
meaning: Indicates the patient meets the equivalent inhaled corticosteroid regimen as specified in the inclusion criterion.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently being treated with a stable daily dosage of an equivalent inhaled corticosteroid in the range of ≥88 and ≤176 micrograms/day for at least 4 weeks before screening.
when_false: Set to false if the patient does not meet all these criteria.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown whether the patient meets all these criteria.

name: patient_meets_non_corticosteroid_regimen
meaning: Indicates the patient meets the non-corticosteroid therapy regimen as specified in the inclusion criterion.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently being treated with a stable daily dosage of non-corticosteroid therapy.
when_false: Set to false if the patient does not meet this criterion.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown whether the patient meets this criterion.

name: patient_meets_ics_laba_regimen
meaning: Indicates the patient meets the inhaled corticosteroid plus long-acting beta2-agonist regimen as specified in the inclusion criterion.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently being treated with a daily dose of an inhaled corticosteroid plus a daily dose of a long-acting beta2-agonist at a dose ≤ fluticasone propionate 100 micrograms/salmeterol 50 micrograms twice daily.
when_false: Set to false if the patient does not meet all these criteria.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown whether the patient meets all these criteria.

name: patient_is_currently_on_permitted_regimen
meaning: Indicates the patient is currently being treated with at least one permitted regimen as specified in the inclusion criterion.
when_true: Set to true if the patient meets at least one of the permitted regimens as specified in the inclusion criterion.
when_false: Set to false if the patient meets none of the permitted regimens.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown whether the patient meets any of the permitted regimens.

name: patient_non_corticosteroid_therapy_value_recorded_now_withunit_per_day
meaning: Numeric value for the patient's current daily dosage of non-corticosteroid therapy, with the unit depending on the specific therapy.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient is not currently being treated with non-corticosteroid therapy or the dosage is unknown.
when_value: Set to the current daily dosage (with appropriate unit) if the patient is currently being treated with non-corticosteroid therapy and the dosage is known.
